recommendation: Address social determinants affecting vaccination access
implementation_steps: Identify and address social determinants that impede vaccine access
Connect patients to community resources or financial assistance programs
Provide tailored education to address vaccine concerns and hesitancy
Build trust among vulnerable populations through culturally sensitive approaches
Coordinate with care team to ensure follow-through on vaccination plans
evidence_summary: Social worker interventions addressing social determinants of health have been shown to improve vaccination rates among vulnerable populations by reducing access barriers and addressing vaccine hesitancy.
citation: Effective Interventions to Increase Routine Childhood Immunization Coverage
